'''Catrelle Mosenain''' was an ironmonger's daughter from [[Maerone]], [[Cairhien]].
==History==
When she told [[Daved Hanlon]] that he made her pregnant, he splits her head upon a rock and throws her down a well.

[[Mili Skane]] tells Hanlon about the incident to prove her knowledge of him. He himself has already forgotten Catrelle's name.
